title: Cockroach protests: parents of Indian students who took their own lives reveal pressure of leaked exam papers and resits

paragraphs.en: When the Indian government announced the resignation of its education minister in late July after weeks of protest, there were widespread celebrations. Students from across the country had joined the mass demonstrations led by the Cockroach Janta party amid growing resentment over repeated examination cancellations and question paper leaks.
paragraphs.zh: 7月下旬，在数周抗议之后，印度政府宣布教育部长辞职，各地广泛欢庆。在对考试一再取消和试卷泄题日益不满的情绪中，来自全国各地的学生加入了由“蟑螂人民党”（Cockroach Janta）领导的声势浩大的示威游行。

paragraphs.en: The pressure of exams in the country has only increased in recent years. The number of student suicides rose from 8,068 in 2014, to 14,488 in 2024 – an increase of roughly 80% – according to the Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India report released by the country’s National Crime Records Bureau. After family problems, failure in examinations has been listed as the leading cause of suicides among students.
paragraphs.zh: 近年来，该国的考试压力有增无减。根据印度国家犯罪记录局发布的《印度意外死亡与自杀报告》，学生自杀人数从2014年的8068人上升到2024年的14488人，增幅约80%。除家庭问题外，考试不及格已被列为学生自杀的主要原因。

paragraphs.en: For families who say they lost their children to education system mismanagement and examination scandals, watching the protest scenes unfold on television came with mixed feelings. Some were happy that future students may be spared the same fate; others questioned why it had taken so long.
paragraphs.zh: 对于那些自称因教育系统管理不善和考试丑闻而失去孩子的家庭来说，在电视上看到抗议场面百感交集。一些人感到欣慰，因为未来的学生或许可以免遭同样的命运；另一些人则质疑为什么花了这么长时间。

paragraphs.en: The Guardian spoke to four families about what happened to their children and how they feel today.
paragraphs.zh: 《卫报》采访了四个家庭，了解他们的孩子遭遇了什么，以及他们今天的心情。

paragraphs.en: Anshika Pandey, the eldest of twin sisters and four siblings, was, her father says, the calmest, quietest and most responsible member of the family. Revision books still lie neatly stacked, bags and accreditation cards hang from the nails where they were last placed. Her ambition was to be a doctor in the community where she lived, to be able to help the “poor people in need of medical care” some day.
paragraphs.zh: 安什卡·潘迪（Anshika Pandey）是双胞胎姐妹中的姐姐，也是四个兄弟姐妹中最大的一个。她的父亲说，她是家里最冷静、最安静、最负责任的人。复习书籍仍整齐地堆放着，书包和资格证卡片还挂在最后一次挂放的钉子上。她的理想是成为自己所在社区的医生，希望有一天能帮助“需要医疗照护的穷人”。

paragraphs.en: Pandey studied for more than 12 hours every day, worked part-time at a store for nearly six hours and slept no more than five hours each night.
paragraphs.zh: 潘迪每天学习超过12个小时，在一家商店做兼职近6个小时，每晚睡眠不超过5小时。

paragraphs.en: This year’s national eligibility cum entrance test (Neet) to gain entrance to medical training was her third attempt at becoming a doctor. After sitting the exam on 3 May, she was hopeful. But on 12 May she learned that the exam had been leaked for the second year in a row and there would be a resit.
paragraphs.zh: 今年的全国资格暨入学考试（Neet）是她第三次为成为医生而冲刺。5月3日参加考试后，她满怀希望。但5月12日她得知，考试连续第二年出现泄题，将进行重考。

paragraphs.en: “Anshika was deeply hurt. She had been hoping to enter college this year and was happy with the exam she had taken. Still, after cancellation, when I tried to console her, all she lamented was how could she hope to give another good exam,” says her father, Indradhar Pandey, a cab driver in Delhi.
paragraphs.zh: “安什卡深受打击。她本希望今年能进入大学，对自己参加的考试也很满意。尽管如此，在考试取消后，我试图安慰她时，她只是哀叹，她怎么可能再考好一次，”她的父亲因德拉达尔·潘迪（Indradhar Pandey）说，他是德里的一名出租车司机。
